title: introduce-stage-aware-concurrency-controller-to-balance-prefill-and-decode
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: high variance in tail latency under mixed prefill/decode workloads; prior static worker ratios either underutilize KPUs during long prefill bursts or cause decode stalls during short interleaved requests. Summary: add a stage-aware Concurrency Controller that dynamically allocates token-credit budgets and worker quotas between prefill and decode stages based on sampled latency and KV-cache hit signals. Controller components: (1) a lightweight sampled tail-latency estimator that keeps P99 and P95 windows per route; (2) a token-credit allocator that issues backpressure tokens to front-end shards and converts credits into decode worker permits; (3) kernel-affinity hints surfaced to the scheduler so prefill-heavy shards prefer fp16 fast-path kernels while decode-heavy shards prefer low-latency kernels; (4) a per-stage soft-eviction policy for KV cache prioritizing decode-prefetch keys when decode pressure is high. Key properties: graceful ramping (add/remove workers over 50ms windows), probe mode for cold routes, safe defaults for dedicated/Dedicated-on-prem rules. Changeset: controller core in runtime/pipeline, changes to scheduler and worker pools, new integration tests and bench configs, documentation and operator knobs. Design doc reference: internal doc link (Linear ENG-9122); also ties to ENG-9140 for KV eviction tuning. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed and linked; - [x] Microbenchmarks show 8-12% median cost reduction for mixed workloads and 18-25% P99 tail improvement in perf-lab canary; - [x] Unit tests added for token-credit accounting; - [x] Integration tests added to perf canary; - [x] Feature gated behind runtime flag runtime.enable_stage_concurrency_controller. Rollout plan: staged canary in perf-canary cluster for 48h, then gradual ramp to 25% traffic with automated rollback on SLO regressed >3% for P99; fallback path: disable flag and controller will drain extra permits then hand back quotas; instrumentation: new metrics pipeline_controller.* and dashboard documented in docs/ops/prefill-decode-controller.md. Testing: local unit tests, perf-lab canaries, and an end-to-end canary against benchmarks/pipeline/canary-config.yaml. Backwards compatibility: non-breaking; runs only when feature flag enabled. Merge notes: squash merge with linked commits and release notes below.

release_notes: Introduce stage-aware concurrency controller for prefill/decode pipelines. Improves P99 tail latency under mixed workloads and reduces cost by better balancing worker utilization. Exposed operator knobs and metrics for observability. Feature gated behind runtime.enable_stage_concurrency_controller.
notes_for_operators: Feature flag: runtime.enable_stage_concurrency_controller=false by default; to enable, flip flag and monitor controller.* metrics and P95/P99 keys on the pipeline dashboard. Use runtime.flags.runtime_concurrency.hysteresis_ms to tune eviction hysteresis. Rollback: set feature flag to false; controller will drain permits within 500ms and restore previous static quotas.
